dataset_description: Synthetic, deterministic fixtures used to evaluate file-signature carving accuracy under contiguous, fragmented and partially overwritten conditions. No real-world data is used.

fixtures.description: Synthetic ZIP-signature fixture. Starts with a ZIP local file header (PK\x03\x04) followed by a synthetic marker, but there is no central directory and no end-of-central-directory record, so it is NOT a valid archive.
fixtures.notes: Used later as a third contiguous ground truth.

fixtures.description: Signature-free control fixture. Pure deterministic filler with no file signature at all. It exists so that signature detection can be measured against a negative case (no signature => nothing may be carved).

Synthetic container with a JPEG signature embedded at byte offset 1024, surrounded by unrelated filler. The embedded segment is NOT a valid, fully parseable JPEG - it has no entropy-coded scan. This is the planned ground truth for the fragmented-file experiment and for the 'signature inside noise' case.
fixtures.notes: Planned ground truth for fragmented carving.

fixtures.description: Synthetic PDF-signature fixture. Begins with the '%PDF-' header so that signature detection has a realistic target, but the file has no xref table, no trailer and no object structure: it is NOT a valid, fully parseable PDF file.
fixtures.notes: Used later as a second contiguous ground truth.

fixtures.description: Synthetic ZIP-signature fixture with a self-delimiting end-of-central-directory record (PK 05 06). It starts with a ZIP local file header, but there is no real central directory and no real archive structure, so it is NOT a valid archive. The record exists so that a carving engine can determine the extent of the candidate.
fixtures.notes: Length-bearing ground truth: allows extent delimitation.

fixtures.description: Synthetic PDF-signature fixture with a self-delimiting %%EOF trailer. It starts with the '%PDF-' header, but it has no xref table, no trailer dictionary and no object structure, so it is NOT a valid, fully parseable PDF file. The trailer exists so that a carving engine can determine the extent of the candidate.
fixtures.notes: Length-bearing ground truth: allows extent delimitation.

fixtures.description: Synthetic JPEG-signature fixture with a self-delimiting end marker (FF D9). It starts with a JPEG SOI/APP0 header and a SOF0 segment, but there are no Huffman or quantisation tables and no entropy-coded scan, so it is NOT a valid, fully parseable JPEG file. The end marker exists so that a carving engine can determine the extent of the candidate and a byte-exact recovery is measurable at all.
fixtures.notes: Length-bearing ground truth: allows extent delimitation.

fixtures.description: Synthetic JPEG-signature fixture. Begins with a JPEG SOI marker and a JFIF APP0 header, but the body is deterministic filler: there is no quantisation table, no Huffman table and no entropy-coded scan, so this is NOT a valid, fully parseable JPEG file.
fixtures.notes: Used later as the 'contiguous file' ground truth.
